before.content:
node-version-file: .node-version
      - run: corepack enable
      - run: corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: ./gradlew :ji-acp-v1-server:runJavaClientConformance :ji-cli:installDist --offline --no-daemon
      - run: corepack pnpm --offline check:acp-v1:typescript-client
      - run: node tooling/acp-conformance/run-typescript-client.mjs --test-agent

after.content:
- run: corepack pnpm --offline check:acp-v1:typescript-client
      - run: node tooling/acp-conformance/run-typescript-client.mjs --test-agent
      - run: corepack pnpm --offline check:acpx
      - run: node tooling/acp-conformance/run-gold-band-smoke.mjs
        env:
          CARGO_NET_OFFLINE: "true"
